conf.comment: arcsight-esm / manager-health / csv-file. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: 'High-side instance, no guard: pass through with Persistent Queue backpressure, split by signature-ID prefix onto the health stream, and rate-limit the monitor:12x counters; leave the CSV parse to the Elastic side.' PQ backpressure is a Destination-level setting and signature-ID prefix splitting is already applied upstream by the connector's destination filter, so neither is pipeline work. Rate-limiting monitor:12x rows is left unimplemented: no target rate is given in the map and no verified Sampling-function conf shape exists for this instance, so it is recorded as an ops-tunable gap in README.md rather than guessed. This pipeline only tags event.dataset.
